name: TOPFAB TF500
notes: Kickstarter campaign (launched 26.08.2026, HK-based, pledges in HKD) was canceled by TOPFAB in early Sep 2026 citing export-control rules for 5-axis CNC; no relaunch announced. Price = last listed Basic Pack Super Early Bird, creator-stated US$5,999 (HK$47,092; incl. basic tooling package); announced MSRP US$8,999. A-axis -110°/+110°, C-axis 360°, max workpiece Ø120 × 100 mm, 5-axis RTCP accuracy 0.05 mm, A/C repeatability 5 arcsec. Spindle 0.65 kW max for 4/6 mm shanks, thermoelectric (semiconductor) cooling; 8-slot random-access ATC with vision tool ID, stereo-vision workpiece positioning, closed-loop position sensing. Machine rated power 1.5 kW.

accessories.name: Dust Collector
accessories.description: Handheld vacuum for collecting dust and machining debris (campaign add-on).

accessories.name: Material Clamps (1 pair)
accessories.description: Workholding clamp jaws for securing stock during machining (campaign add-on).
